test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Grandfather of Sukhdev and Baldev divided an amount of Rs.2,150 among them in the ratio 20 : 23. They both donated Rs.100 each for charity out of their shares. What will be the ratio of their respective amounts?
solution:
**Given:**

Sharing ratio of the amount to be divided between Sukhdev and Baldev = 20 : 23

Amount to be divided between Sukhdev and Baldev = Rs.2150 

**Calculation:**

Share of Sukhdev = 2150 × 20/43 = 1000

Share of Sukhdev after donating = Rs.1000 - Rs.100 = Rs.900

Share of Baldev = 2150 × 23/43 = Rs.1150

Share of Baldev after donating = Rs.1150 - Rs.100 = Rs.1050

**∴ New ratio of the shares of Sukhdev and Baldev = 900 : 1050 **

**⇒ 6 : 7 **
